body.name: \Sigma_J
body.def: \Sigma_J=\{b\in[0,1]^K:b_i=0\text{ for }i\notin J,\ \sum_{i\in J}b_i=1\},\quad \operatorname{int}\Sigma_J=\{b\in\Sigma_J:b_i>0\text{ for every }i\in J\}
body.role: simplex of second-batch allocations supported on survivor set \(J\), with \(\operatorname{int}\Sigma_J\) denoting relative interior
